pe_assessment: Snapshot trailing/forward P/E 44.02/27.40 leaves limited room for acquisition and margin disappointment. Neutral reflects a material valuation/leverage tradeoff, not missing financial extraction.
margin_analysis: Q2 segment margin 23.1%, down 80bp; adjusted EPS $3.15 versus GAAP $2.11 includes $1.04 of amortization, acquisition and restructuring adjustments.
debt_analysis: Debt $20.611bn rose from $9.895bn; cash/investments $0.695bn. H1 derived FCF $1.188bn improved, but $11.079bn acquisition payments required financing.
growth_outlook: Sales grew 21%, organic growth 14%, and electrical backlog 43%. FY adjusted EPS $13.40–13.60 is prospective, versus nearly flat guided GAAP EPS.
summary: Demand and cash generation are strong, but doubled debt and a premium valuation balance the upside. Neutral is supported by this observed risk/reward tradeoff.
